summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing senior management changes approved by its Board on August 31, 2026. Sergio Andrés Moreno Acevedo ceased as Corporate Vice President of Science, Technology and Innovation, replaced in an acting capacity by Diana Marcela Acero Rojas effective September 1, 2026. Henryk Manuel Porras Villamil was appointed Acting Executive Vice President of Energy Transition, succeeding Ernesto Alfonso Gómez Cabarcas, who took statutory leave. These abrupt departures and acting appointments constitute management changes. Permanent appointments will be disclosed later. No deal terms apply; watch for permanent executive selections.
